3. Chuan dau ra
3.1. Chuan dau ra vè kien thirc
PLO1. Kien thurc nen tang va chuyen nganh. Van dung kién thurc giao duc dai cuong,
co so nganh va chuyen nganh thiet ke do hoa cong nghe so de phan tich, danh gia va giai
quyét cac van de trong hoat dong thiét ke, truyen thong va san xuat san pham do hoa theo
yeu cau thuc tien nghe nghiep.
PLO2. Kién thurc tham my, van hoa va xu huong thiet ke. Van dung kien thurc my
hoc, van hba thi giac, lich su va xu huong thiet ke de dinh huong tu duy tham my, phat trien
ngon ngur tao hinh va xay dung phong cach thiet ke phu hop voi boi canh xa hoi va thi truong
duong dai.
3
PLO3. Kien thurc cong nghe va quy trinh san xuat so. Hieu va van dung duroc cong
nghe so, nen tang truyen thong s6 va quy trinh san xuat san pham do hoa trong thiet ke, minh
hoa, chuyen dong hinh anh va phat trien he thong truyen thong thi giac hien dai.
3.2. Chuan dau ra ve ky nang
PLO4. Ky nang sang tao va trien khai giai phap thiet ke. Hinh thanh va trien khai giai
phap thiet ke do hoa cong nghe s6 bao dam tinh tham my, cong nang, trai nghiem nguoi
dung va hieu qua truyen thong trong boi canh du an cu the.
PLO5. Ky nang lam viec chuyen nghiep va giao tiep. Lam viec hieu qua trong moi
truong doc lap va nh6m; co kha nang giao tiep, thuyét trinh, phan bien va phoi hop v6i cac
ben lien quan; Sur dung dugc ngoai ngu ? trinh do tuong duong bac 3/6 theo Khung nang
lurc ngoai ngu 6 bac dung cho Viet Nam, dap urng yeu cau giao tiép, hoc tap, nghien curu va
lam viec co ban trong linh vurc dao tao; sur dung dugc thanh thao cong cu chuyen mon phuc
vu hoat dong nghe nghiep.
3.3. Chuan dau ra ve murc do tu chi va trach nhiem
nghiep, tuan thu phap luat va quy dinh ve ban quyen; co trach nhiem xa hoi va dinh huong
phat trien ben vung; c6 kha nang ty hoc, thich ung voi su thay doi cua cong nghe va thi
truong trong linh vrc thiet ké.
3.4. Vi tri viec lam ma sinh vien co the dam nhigm sau khi tot nghiep
Sinh vien tot nghiep chuong trinh Cur nhan Thiét ke Do hoa Cong nghe so c6 kha
nang lam viec trong cac to chuc thuoc khu vuc cong lap, tu nhan va cac to chuc phi chinh
phu hoat dong trong linh vyc thiet ke, truyen thong, cong nghiep van hoa va sang tao. Voi
nen tang dao tao tich hop gitra my thuat, cong nghe va tur duy thiet ke, cung cac dinh huong
chuyen sau nhu Game art, Minh hoa va Thiet ke nhan dien thuong hieu, nguoi hoc co the
dam nhiem nhieu vi tri viec lam da dang trong he sinh thai sang tao.
(1) Nhomvi tri chuyenmon thiet keva sanxuat
Nguoi hoc co the lam viec trrc tiép trong cac bo phan thiét ke cua doanh nghiep,
cong ty truyen thong, studio sang tao hoac cac to churc san xuat noi dung so voi vai tro:
Nha thiét ke do hoa (Graphic Designer): Thiét ke cac san pham truyen thong, an
pham, hinh anh so tren nhieu nen tang khac nhau.
Hoa st minh hoa (llustrator): Sang tao hinh anh minh hoa phuc vu xuat ban, quang
cao, truyen thong va noi dung so.
Thiet ke nhan dien thuong hieu (Brand Designer): Xay dung va phat trien he thong
nhan dien thuong hieu, dam bao tinh nhat quan ve ngon ngu thi giac.
Hoa st Game (Game Artist): Thiet ke nhan vat, boi canh va tai san hinh anh trong cac
san pham tro choi va moi truong tuong tac so.

Sinh vien tot nghiep co the tham gia vao cac bo phan sang tao voi vai tro xay dung y
tuong va phat trien noi dung:
Chuyen vien sang tao (Creative/Content Designer): De xuat va phat trien y tuong
cho san pham, thuong hieu va chien dich truyen thong.
Thiet ke da phuong tien (Multimedia Designer): San xuat noi dung hinh anh, chuyen
dong va tuong tac phuc vu cac nen tang so va truyen thong da phuong tien.
(3) Nhom vi tri quan ly va dieu phoi thiet ke
Voi kinh nghiem tich luy, nguoi hoc c6 the phat trien len cac vi tri quan ly trong linh
vurc thiet ke:
Chuyen vien/Quan ly thiet ke (Design Executive/Design Manager): To chirc, dieu
phoi va giam sat hoat dong thiet ke trong doanh nghiep; phoi hop voi cac doi tac trong va
ngoai nuoc.
Giam doc sang tao (Creative Director): Dinh huong chien lurgc sang tao, xay durng
hinh anh thuong hieu va dan dat cac chien dich truyen thong.
Giam doc thiet ké (Design Director): Quan ly tong the hoat dong thiét ke, kiem soat
chat luong va hieu qua trien khai dy an.
(4) Nhom vi tri nghien ciru, giang day va phat trien chuyen mon
Nguoi hoc c6 the tiep tuc hoc tap nang cao va tham gia:
Giang day va nghien cuu: Giang day, nghien curu trong linh vrc thiet ke do hoa, my
thuat urng dung tai cac co so dao tao va vien nghien curu trong va ngoai nuoc, khi dap urng
yeu cau ve trinh do theo quy dinh.
(5) Nhom vi tri kinh doanh, khoi nghiep va cac linh vuc lien quan
Ngoai ra, nguoi hoc co kha nang tham gia vao cac hoat dong kinh doanh va phat trien
san pham sang tao:
Khoi nghiep sang tao: Thanh lap doanh nghiep, studio thiet ke, cung cap dich vu sang
tao va truyen thong.
Chuyen vien phat trien san pham sang tao: Tham gia xay dung va phat trien cac san
pham thiet ke trong doanh nghiep.
Cac vi tri lien quan: Lam viec trong linh vrc san xuat noi dung so, quan ly chat luong
san pham thiét ke, hoac tai cac co quan quan ly nha nuoc lien quan den my thuat ung dung
va cong nghiep van hoa.
5
3.5. Kha nang hoc tap, nang cao trinh do sau khi tot nghiep
Sinh vien tot nghiep chuong trinh dao tao Thiet ke do hoa c6 the hoc lén cao hoc cac
nganh lien quan dén thiet ké, my thuat urng dung va cac chuyen nganh phu hop khac trong
danh muc thong ke nganh dao tao cua Bo Giao duc va dao tao.
